Method variable_selection()

Fast backward variable selection with penalization (rms::fastbw)

Usage

RegressionModel$variable_selection(update = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

update

If TRUE, restrict the model's formula and terms to the selected variables. The model must then be fitted again with $fit().

...

Further arguments passed to rms::fastbw, e.g. rule or sls.

Returns

Character vector of the selected (retained) variables.
